reach_points: Only POST /ingestion/cases/{caseId}/uploads (large-original.ts create) throws 429 UPLOAD_QUOTA; retention budgets use their own codes.
Studio sends it only from upload-command.ts openReceipt (fresh uploads; a resume reads status, never creates).
Map Add files -> IntakeDropDialog -> retainBatch: the batch page row (DropOutcomes) and its Try again button.
Map Add files -> TableImportDialog -> useRetainTable: the dialog status line and its Retry upload button.
design: createWhenFree wraps the create call: a 429 UPLOAD_QUOTA naming open_receipts, open_receipts_operator or open_receipts_case publishes phase waiting and asks again with the same body.

Backoff doubles 2 s to 30 s; when freesAt is sooner the next ask is 0.5 s after it. Outer bound 30 minutes, then phase stopped with SLOT_STOPPED words and the existing Retry upload / Try again, which waits again.
A module line of tickets (made with each command) keeps drop order: only the earliest waiting command asks; a later one says an earlier file goes first.
Words name the published count from upload-limits: Waiting for a free upload slot; 2 of your uploads are open. It starts by itself.
open_bytes, case_retained_bytes, storage_capacity, any other 429 code and every non-429 error stop as before with the server words.
IntakeDropDialog: the progress column is blank while waiting, so no byte count is shown for bytes not sent.
inputs: Fakes only: published upload-limits enums, synthetic 429 UPLOAD_QUOTA bodies with and without freesAt, 429 AREA_LIMIT and 500.
